#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <cuda.h>

#ifndef Real_t 
#define Real_t float
#endif

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
           const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
            size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
           const size_t n)
{ 
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t low = 0;
  size_t high = n;
  while (high - low > 1) {
    size_t mid = low + (high - low)/2;
    if (z < acc_a[mid])
      high = mid;
    else
      low = mid;
  }
  acc_r[i] = low;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS2 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned  nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    if (r < n && z >= acc_a[r]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    size_t w = r < n ? r : n; 
    if (z >= acc_a[w]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS4 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  __shared__  size_t k;

  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  size_t lid = threadIdx.x; 

  if (lid == 0) {
    unsigned nbits = 0;
    while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
    k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  }
  __syncthreads();

  size_t p = k;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[p] <= z) ? p : 0;
  while (p >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | p;
    size_t w = r < n ? r : n;
    if (z >= acc_a[w]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <cuda.h>

#ifndef Real_t 
#define Real_t float
#endif

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
           const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
            size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
           const size_t n)
{ 
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t low = 0;
  size_t high = n;
  while (high - low > 1) {
    size_t mid = low + (high - low)/2;
    if (z < acc_a[mid])
      high = mid;
    else
      low = mid;
  }
  acc_r[i] = low;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS2 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned  nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    if (r < n && z >= acc_a[r]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS3 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    size_t w = r < n ? r : n; 
    if (z >= acc_a[w]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS4 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  __shared__  size_t k;

  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  size_t lid = threadIdx.x; 

  if (lid == 0) {
    unsigned nbits = 0;
    while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
    k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  }
  __syncthreads();

  size_t p = k;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[p] <= z) ? p : 0;
  while (p >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | p;
    size_t w = r < n ? r : n;
    if (z >= acc_a[w]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

template <typename T>
void bs ( const size_t aSize,
    const size_t zSize,
    const T *d_a,  // N+1
    const T *d_z,  // T
    size_t *d_r,   // T
    const size_t n,
    const int repeat )
{
  dim3 grids ((zSize + 255) / 256);
  dim3 blocks (256);
  auto start = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();

  for (int i = 0; i < repeat; i++)
    kernel_BS<<<grids, blocks>>>(d_a, d_z, d_r, zSize, n);

  cudaDeviceSynchronize();
  auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now();
  auto time = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::nanoseconds>(end - start).count();
  std::cout << "Average kernel execution time (bs1) " << (time * 1e-9f) / repeat << " (s)\n";
}

#include <cstdlib>

#include <cuda.h>

#ifndef Real_t 
#define Real_t float
#endif

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
           const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
            size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
           const size_t n)
{ 
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t low = 0;
  size_t high = n;
  while (high - low > 1) {
    size_t mid = low + (high - low)/2;
    if (z < acc_a[mid])
      high = mid;
    else
      low = mid;
  }
  acc_r[i] = low;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS2 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned  nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    if (r < n && z >= acc_a[r]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <cuda.h>

#ifndef Real_t 
#define Real_t float
#endif

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
           const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
            size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
           const size_t n)
{ 
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t low = 0;
  size_t high = n;
  while (high - low > 1) {
    size_t mid = low + (high - low)/2;
    if (z < acc_a[mid])
      high = mid;
    else
      low = mid;
  }
  acc_r[i] = low;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS2 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned  nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    if (r < n && z >= acc_a[r]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

kernel_BS4 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,

             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,

  __shared__  size_t k;

  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;

#include <cstdlib>
#include <chrono>
#include <iostream>
#include <cuda.h>

#ifndef Real_t 
#define Real_t float
#endif

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
           const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
            size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,
           const size_t n)
{ 
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t low = 0;
  size_t high = n;
  while (high - low > 1) {
    size_t mid = low + (high - low)/2;
    if (z < acc_a[mid])
      high = mid;
    else
      low = mid;
  }
  acc_r[i] = low;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS2 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  unsigned  nbits = 0;
  while (n >> nbits) nbits++;
  size_t k = 1ULL << (nbits - 1);
  T z = acc_z[i];
  size_t idx = (acc_a[k] <= z) ? k : 0;
  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    if (r < n && z >= acc_a[r]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
           const size_t zSize,

{

  T z = acc_z[i];

  while (k >>= 1) {
    size_t r = idx | k;
    size_t w = r < n ? r : n; 
    if (z >= acc_a[w]) { 
      idx = r;
    }
  }
  acc_r[i] = idx;
}

template <typename T>
__global__ void
kernel_BS4 (const T* __restrict__ acc_a,
            const T* __restrict__ acc_z,
             size_t* __restrict__ acc_r,
            const size_t zSize,
            const size_t n)
{
  __shared__  size_t k;

  size_t i = blockIdx.x*blockDim.x+threadIdx.x;
  if (i >= zSize) return;
  size_t lid = threadIdx.x; 

  if (lid == 0) {
    unsigned nbits = 0;

#ifdef DEBUG
void verify(Real_t *a, Real_t *z, size_t *r, size_t aSize, size_t zSize, std::string msg)
{
  for (size_t i = 0; i < zSize; ++i)
  {
    // check result
    if (!(r[i]+1 < aSize && a[r[i]] <= z[i] && z[i] < a[r[i] + 1]))
    {

      std::cout << "index = " << i << " r[index] = " << r[i] << std::endl;
      std::cout << a[r[i]] << " <= " << z[i] << " < " << a[r[i] + 1] << std::endl;

    // clear result
    r[i] = 0xFFFFFFFF;
  }
}

int main(int argc, char* argv[])
{
  if (argc != 3) {
    std::cout << "Usage ./main <number of elements> <repeat>\n";
    return 1;
  }

  size_t numElem = atol(argv[1]);
  uint repeat = atoi(argv[2]);

  srand(2);
  size_t aSize = numElem;
  size_t zSize = 2*aSize;
  Real_t *a = NULL;
  Real_t *z = NULL;
  size_t *r = NULL;
  posix_memalign((void**)&a, 1024, aSize * sizeof(Real_t));
  posix_memalign((void**)&z, 1024, zSize * sizeof(Real_t));
  posix_memalign((void**)&r, 1024, zSize * sizeof(size_t));

  size_t N = aSize-1;

  // strictly ascending
  for (size_t i = 0; i < aSize; i++) a[i] = i;

  // lower = 0, upper = n-1
  for (size_t i = 0; i < zSize; i++) z[i] = rand() % N;

  Real_t* d_a;
  Real_t* d_z;
  size_t *d_r;
  cudaMalloc((void**)&d_a, sizeof(Real_t)*aSize);
  cudaMalloc((void**)&d_z, sizeof(Real_t)*zSize);
  cudaMalloc((void**)&d_r, sizeof(size_t)*zSize);
  cudaMemcpy(d_a, a, sizeof(Real_t)*aSize, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);
  cudaMemcpy(d_z, z, sizeof(Real_t)*zSize, cudaMemcpyHostToDevice);

  bs(aSize, zSize, d_a, d_z, d_r, N, repeat);

#ifdef DEBUG
  cudaMemcpy(r, d_r, sizeof(size_t)*zSize, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
  verify(a, z, r, aSize, zSize, "bs");
#endif

  bs2(aSize, zSize, d_a, d_z, d_r, N, repeat);

#ifdef DEBUG
  cudaMemcpy(r, d_r, sizeof(size_t)*zSize, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
  verify(a, z, r, aSize, zSize, "bs2");
#endif

  bs3(aSize, zSize, d_a, d_z, d_r, N, repeat);

#ifdef DEBUG
  cudaMemcpy(r, d_r, sizeof(size_t)*zSize, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
  verify(a, z, r, aSize, zSize, "bs3");
#endif

  bs4(aSize, zSize, d_a, d_z, d_r, N, repeat);

#ifdef DEBUG
  cudaMemcpy(r, d_r, sizeof(size_t)*zSize, cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost);
  verify(a, z, r, aSize, zSize, "bs4");
#endif

  cudaFree(d_a);
  cudaFree(d_z);
  cudaFree(d_r);
  free(a);
  free(z);
  free(r);
  return 0;
}

prediction.gridSz_explanation: From main(), argv[1]=16384 gives numElem=aSize=16384 and zSize=2*aSize=32768. The first invocation of the target kernel occurs in bs(), which launches kernel_BS with grids=(zSize+255)/256=128 and blocks=256, so the launch is one-dimensional with 128 blocks.
prediction.blockSz_explanation: In bs(), the block configuration is explicitly set as dim3 blocks(256) before the first kernel launch. Therefore each block contains 256 threads in x and 1 in y,z.
prediction.fp32_flop_explanation: The target kernel is kernel_BS<float>, but its work is comparisons and integer index arithmetic only; there are no explicit floating-point arithmetic operations such as add/mul/fma. The float compare z < acc_a[mid] is not counted as a FLOP under the stated rules, so the first invocation executes 0 FP32 FLOPs.
prediction.fp64_flop_explanation: No double-precision variables or arithmetic appear in the kernel body, and template instantiation uses float (Real_t defaults to float). Thus the first invocation performs no FP64 arithmetic.
prediction.fp16_flop_explanation: The kernel is instantiated for float, not half, and there are no half-precision arithmetic operations in the source. Without SASS evidence of compiler-generated FP16 helper arithmetic, the defensible source-level estimate is zero FP16 FLOPs.
prediction.dram_bytes_read_explanation: There are 32768 active threads (128*256 exactly equals zSize), each reading acc_z[i] once and then performing a binary search over n=aSize-1=16383. Since high starts at n and the loop continues while high-low>1, each thread executes 14 iterations (ceil(log2(16383))=14), reading one acc_a[mid] float per iteration; total source-level reads are 32768*(1+14) floats = 491520 floats = 1,966,080 B, and the unique footprint (d_a: 16384 floats = 65536 B, d_z: 32768 floats = 131072 B, total 196608 B) fits well within the 5 MB L2, so DRAM traffic is best estimated as the compulsory unique read footprint only.
prediction.dram_bytes_written_explanation: Each active thread writes one size_t result to acc_r[i], for a unique output footprint of 32768*8 = 262144 B. Because this write footprint is far smaller than the 5 MB L2 cache, the dirty output lines can remain resident in L2 during this first kernel invocation, so the best estimate of DRAM bytes written during the invocation itself is 0.
